No other call sites in the repo. All three `InventoryService::save` call sites are now covered — `orders.save(p1)` is `OrderService::save`, a different method, correctly left untouched.

**Summary:** ast-tool's `callers`/`references` returned empty for `store::InventoryService::save` even after retrying (member-call resolution gap), so I verified call sites with Grep and confirmed each caller's type via source inspection. Added `std::cerr << "[log] inventory save\n";` before both calls in `src/main.cpp` (and added the needed `<iostream>` include) and before the call in `src/service/order_service.cpp`.
